defStrong: to bear together (contribute), i.e. (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage
defKjv: be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit(-able for)
derivacion: from G4862 (σύν) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate);
